hero.eyebrow: you're studying to understand, not to pass
hero.title: Teach the AI.
hero.lead: The test of knowing something is being able to explain it. In Tutorla the AI is the student — you are the teacher.

mock.subject: maths
mock.title: Chain rule
mock.ai1: I know a bit of differentiation. But where does the name “chain rule” come from? What's the chain?
mock.me1: Think of nested functions: f(g(x)). You take the derivative of the outer one and multiply by the derivative of the inner. Like links in a chain.
mock.ai2: Okay, links make sense. But why do we multiply instead of add? Can you show me with an example?
mock.gap: gap: why we multiply isn't explained
mock.note: Your student keeps getting stuck on “why”. Try explaining with cause and effect.

ters.title: Every learning app teaches you. Tutorla wants to learn.
ters.quote: Students assume they understood. Real understanding only shows up when you try to explain it to someone — that's when you find out which step you memorised.
ters.gapNote: Practice tests catch the gap but never show you why.

nasil.title: A session in four steps
nasil.s1d: Exam mode, subject, topic. YKS → maths → derivatives → chain rule.
nasil.s2d: Curious, sceptical or impatient. Each one pushes you from a different side.
nasil.s3d: Type, talk, draw on the board or upload a photo of your notebook. Your student listens and asks.
nasil.s4d: The understanding map marks every concept. The session note tells you how you explained.

personalar.title: Pick your student.
personalar.note: Mascots are being drawn — placeholders for now.
personalar.p1t: Asks a lot, says “why”, wants to go deeper.
personalar.p1q: Hmm, I think I got the multiplying part. If you told me why it works, it would really click.
personalar.p2t: Isn't convinced, looks for counter-examples, wants reasons.
personalar.p2q: Does this always hold? What if I find a counter-example?
personalar.p3t: Wants to move fast, expects a summary; forces you to simplify.
personalar.p3q: Okay okay, what's the shortest version? Three sentences.

neden.title: We learn by teaching.
neden.c1d: If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it yet. Tutorla tests exactly that, every session.
neden.c2d: Students who prepare to teach learn more deeply than students who prepare for a test. The research keeps showing it.
neden.c3d: Seneca, two thousand years ago: by teaching, we learn. That line is where the brand starts.
neden.examsText: There is no other app that speaks Turkish, knows the YKS curriculum, and wants to learn from you instead of teaching you. That intersection is empty — Tutorla is being built there.

erken.title: Be one of the first students.
erken.text: We'll test the web version with a closed group. If you're preparing for an exam and tired of memorising, we're looking for you.
erken.successText: We'll let you know when the closed test starts.
erken.honest: In the making — the first closed test runs with 5–10 students.
erken.failed: Couldn't save that — try again in a moment?
